content.text: Section 18 fully satisfies the preferred position, so no redline is needed.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 meets the preferred position in full: Vendor must carry CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law (plus employer's liability of USD 1M), professional E&O of USD 2M, and cyber/privacy liability of USD 5M — appropriate given Vendor hosts and processes Customer Data under sections 15 and 17. Coverage runs through the term and for one year afterward, matching our model language. Clause 18.2 adds certificates of insurance on request, reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities — all favourable to us. No redline required.
